annual_mean_temp_f.label: Annual mean temperature
fields: ISD mandatory air temperature (pos 88-92) + QC flag (93)
annual_mean_temp_f.aggregation: hourly mean -> daily mean (days with >=18 valid hours) -> mean over all valid days

winter_mean_temp_f.label: Winter (DJF) mean temperature
winter_mean_temp_f.aggregation: mean of valid daily means for months 12,1,2

summer_mean_temp_f.label: Summer (JJA) mean temperature
summer_mean_temp_f.aggregation: mean of valid daily means for months 6,7,8

diurnal_temp_range_f.label: Mean diurnal range (daily max - min)
diurnal_temp_range_f.aggregation: mean over valid days of (max hourly - min hourly)

hot_days_per_year.label: Days >= 90°F per year
hot_days_per_year.aggregation: count(valid days with daily max >= 32.2°C) / n_valid_days * 365.25

freeze_days_per_year.label: Days with min <= 32°F per year
freeze_days_per_year.aggregation: count(valid days with daily min <= 0°C) / n_valid_days * 365.25

annual_precip_in.label: Annual precipitation
fields: ISD AA1 liquid precipitation, 1-hour period, depth (mm) + QC
annual_precip_in.aggregation: sum of 1-h totals per local day (0 if station operating but no report) -> sum / n_valid_days * 365.25
annual_precip_in.missing: days with <18 temp hours -> null (not 0); ASOS reports 1-h total only when non-zero

wet_days_per_year.label: Wet days (>= 0.04 in) per year
wet_days_per_year.aggregation: count(valid days with precip >= 1 mm) / n_valid_days * 365.25

summer_precip_fraction.label: Share of precipitation falling in JJA

frozen_precip_days_per_year.label: Frozen-precipitation days per year (proxy for snow days)
frozen_precip_days_per_year.aggregation: count(valid days with precip >= 1 mm and daily mean temp <= 0°C) / n_valid_days * 365.25
frozen_precip_days_per_year.missing: AJ1 snow depth coverage was too sparse at ASOS stations; this proxy uses temperature + precipitation only

summer_dewpoint_f.label: Summer (JJA) mean dew point
fields: ISD mandatory dew point (pos 94-98) + QC flag (99)
summer_dewpoint_f.aggregation: hourly mean -> daily mean -> mean over JJA valid days

annual_dewpoint_depression_f.label: Mean dew-point depression (T - Td)
annual_dewpoint_depression_f.aggregation: mean over valid days of (daily mean temp - daily mean dew point); larger = drier air

mean_wind_mph.label: Mean wind speed
fields: ISD mandatory wind speed (pos 66-69, m/s*10) + QC flag (70)
mean_wind_mph.aggregation: hourly mean -> daily mean -> mean over valid days
mean_wind_mph.missing: hourly nulls skipped; calm reported as 0

mean_visibility_mi.label: Mean visibility
fields: ISD mandatory visibility (pos 79-84, m) + QC flag (85)
mean_visibility_mi.aggregation: hourly mean -> daily mean -> mean over valid days
mean_visibility_mi.note: ASOS visibility saturates at 10 mi; excluded from clustering/similarity
